name: service1

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the current catalog of scored records to compute the average.

description: Serves the average-score endpoint for API Consumers: fetches the current catalog from service2 on every request and returns the sum of scores divided by the record count, truncated to a whole number. The same computation runs regardless of which catalog service2 is currently serving. Logs how many records it handled per request. Any request to a path this service does not serve returns a structured 404 body. Does not store or modify any record data, and does not implement sign-in — access is open.
